IN ORDER TO PARK THE VAN IN FRONT OF THE PLATFORM AT GE'S FACILITIES, MR. ARROYO HAD TO OPEN THE DOORS OF THE VAN PRIOR TO PARKING AGAINST THE PLATFORM. AT THE AREA OF THE PARKING LOT THERE WAS A DOWNHILL, AND WHILE TRYING TO PARK THE VAN IN FRONT OF THE PLATFORM, THE TOTE TANK FELL FROM THE VAN, IN THE PARKING AREA, CAUSING THE MATERIAL TO LEAK FROM THE TOTE TANK, ALL OVER THE PARKING LOT. MR. ARROYO IMMEDIATELY NOTIFIED MR. GUZMAN, THE LABORATORY TECHNICIAN OF GENERAL ELECTRIC, AND A GROUP OF EMPLOYEES WERE IMMEDIATELY ACTIVATED TO CONTROL THE SPILL OF THIS MATERIAL. IN ADDITION, MR. ARROYO NOTIFIED OCHOA INDUSTRIAL SALES CORPORATION AND ENSCO CARIBE, INC. REPORTING THE INCIDENT TO THE FOLLOWING CONTACTS: EVANGELISTA OJEDA, JUAN RAUL TRIGO, MARIA TERESA MENDEZ, BERNARDO GONZALEZ, FERDINAND BANCHS AND RAFAEL CORTIJO.

properties.content:

Nearest City: UT

Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: NATURAL GAS
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: WILLIAMS COMPANIES
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.900833, -110.058889 (Explicit)
Report Description/// THIS IS A 48HR PHMSA UPDATE TO NRC REPORT #"S 1397151 & 1397166 /// UPDATED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: WILLIAMS COMPANY REPORTED TO THE NRC REGARDING # 1397151 THAT THE RELIEF VALVE RV414 AT THE JL40-47 JUNCTION LIFTED. THIS OCCURRED 3 TIMES RELEASING APPROX. 3.46 MILLION STANDARD CUBIC FT OF GAS TOTAL. AT 1947 THE COMPANY REPORTED TO THE NRC REGARDING # 1397166 THAT THE RELIEF VALVE RV417 AT THE GREEN RIVER STATION LIFTED RELEASING APPROX. 14.3 MILLION STANDARD CUBIC FT OF GAS OVER THE COURSE OF AN HOUR. BOTH PSV"S OPERATED AS DESIGNED BOTH RELEASES OCCURRED BETWEEN 1200 PM AND 1300 PM (MT). THEY CURRENTLY BELIEVE THE CAUSE OF THE EVENT WAS FROM HIGH PRESSURE ON THE PIPELINE THAT WAS DUE IN PART TO COMPRESSOR SHUT DOWNS AT A COMPRESSOR STATION ON THE SYSTEM. IN ADDITION TO THE COMPRESSOR SHUTDOWN AT ONE STATION, ANOTHER COMPRESSOR STATION WAS SHUTDOWN FOR PLANNED MAINTENANCE. A DELIVERY TO A CUSTOMER WAS CLOSED FOR A PROJECT DURING THE SAME TIME PERIOD. THE RESULT OF THESE OUTAGES LEAD TO ELEVATED BUT INTOLERANCE PRESSURES ON MAIN LINE 40. THE UNEXPECTED SHUTDOWN OF THE COMPRESSOR STATION FURTHER ELEVATED PRESSURE IN THE LINE. THESE INCIDENTS HAVE SINCE BEEN COMBINED DUE TO THE SHARED CAUSAL FACTORS. INVESTIGATION IS STILL ON GOING AS TO CONCLUSIVE FACTORS AND AN UPDATE WILL BE PROVIDED IN THE 30 DAY REPORT.
